queries.purpose: Check whether PyTorch/CUDA stream, wait_event, CUDAGraph replay, and non-blocking copy semantics support a side-stream gather_copy_and_scatter admission mechanism guarded by explicit stream waits.
queries.query: PyTorch CUDA streams CUDAGraph replay current stream wait_event side stream non_blocking copy documentation 2026

sources.title: PyTorch torch.cuda.Stream documentation
sources.relevance: Documents CUDA streams and wait_event/wait_stream synchronization used to sequence side-stream cache admission before dependent default-stream reads or execution-buffer reuse.

sources.title: PyTorch CUDAGraph documentation
sources.relevance: Documents replay of captured static CUDA work; opt016 keeps the existing captured update graph and only changes the stream used for explicit opt-in replay.

sources.title: PyTorch CUDA Graphs notes
sources.relevance: Reinforces static-memory and synchronization constraints for safe CUDA Graph replay; opt016 does not allocate inside capture and records explicit events around replay.

sources.title: River861/RetrievalAttention
sources.relevance: The target repository provides the installed RetroInfer block-cache update path and custom gather_copy_and_scatter kernel; opt016 modifies that project-native path rather than importing new infrastructure.

material_updates.action: Implement opt-in side-stream block-cache admission instead of importing a new KV offload/runtime stack.
material_updates.finding: The project already has CUDA stream/event primitives and an installed gather_copy_and_scatter kernel; PyTorch stream wait_event/wait_stream and CUDAGraph replay semantics are sufficient for a bounded Python/runtime mechanism.
material_updates.impact: Add RETROINFER_ASYNC_CACHE_ADMISSION as a default-off runtime flag, launch admission on per-device side streams, and enqueue waits before later execution-buffer reuse or same-layer cache read.

material_updates.action: Keep correctness gating before any speed or memory claim.
material_updates.finding: Side-stream replay changes ordering and shared execution-buffer lifetime; correctness must be measured with canonical --use_cuda_graph enabled before comparing throughput.
material_updates.impact: Only raw A100 120000x8/gen_len=100/cache_ratio=0.05 runs with clean return code and RETROINFER_OUTPUT_JSON.all_outputs_contain_groundtruth=true can be retained.

decision_impact: Proceed with a default-off async cache-admission implementation and measure opt013-capacity isolation first; lower-memory schedules remain bounded by the mission-specified correctness and no-worse-throughput retention gate.
